general.dl: Rolling — apply by mid-Sept for best odds/merit
general.note: Premed powerhouse: UPMC (one of the largest hospital systems in the US) wrapped around campus, elite research access, guaranteed-admit med pathways for top students. His band is below their middle — keep as the quality reach and apply the first week it opens.
general.medNote: Merit for OOS is scarce; net ~$54k. Worth it only if he’d pick it over every target.

program.name: Guaranteed Admit Program (Pitt Med)
program.req: Verified minimum: SAT 1500/ACT 34; no numeric GPA published (site: “highest GPA available at their high school”)
program.note: Interview required, holistic factors named (research, community service, leadership) alongside stats. Only in play if test scores jump.
